0022600229.text: The Dallas Mavericks (7-4) take on the Minnesota Timberwolves (8-3) in the 12th game of Dallas's season, with the Mavericks riding a three-game win streak and a 7-3 record over their last ten, while Minnesota has won four straight and sits 0.5 games back in the Northwest. Dallas is 2-2 on the road and Minnesota is 4-1 at home, and the Mavericks are missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation), with Morez Johnson Jr. day-to-day with a leg injury and a game-time decision. The Timberwolves are without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and the teams have not played each other yet this season, following a 2025-26 series in which Dallas lost all four meetings, including a 124-94 defeat in Dallas on March 30.
